Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 28 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sonali - 60 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vikram - 59 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Rajesh - 33 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama
5. Anjali - 32 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The metro platform - a shining floor, a display board

Scene 1: The metro platform - Day

[Vinod stands on the platform. Sonali and Vikram stand near him.]

Vinod: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod runs to catch the train.]

Vikram: "Oh wow!"

[Vinod is pushed in the crowd and nearly falls.]

Sonali: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
